mapper.select:
SELECT bi.pid AS pid, MAX(r.time) AS time, bi.type AS type,
CASE WHEN bi.type = 'entry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_entry WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'extry' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_extry WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'swap' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'swapOut' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'swapEnter' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_swap WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'sell' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sell WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'sre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_sre WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'buy' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_buy WHERE id = bi.class) WHEN bi.type = 'bre' THEN (SELECT number FROM is_bre WHERE id = bi.class) ELSE '' END AS number,
CASE bi.direction WHEN 0 THEN '减少' WHEN 1 THEN '增加' ELSE '' END AS info, bi.nums AS nums FROM is_batch_info bi LEFT JOIN is_record r ON ((bi.type = 'swapOut' OR bi.type = 'swapEnter' OR bi.type = 'swap') AND r.type = 'swap' AND bi.class = r.source) OR (bi.type NOT IN ('swapOut', 'swapEnter', 'swap') AND bi.type = r.type AND bi.class = r.source) WHERE
bi.pid IN
#{pidValue}
AND bi.type IN
#{typeValue}
AND r.time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.startTime})
AND r.time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{batchDetailQuery.endTime})
AND bi.class IN ( SELECT id FROM is_entry WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_extry WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_swap WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_sell WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_sre WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_buy WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') UNION ALL SELECT id FROM is_bre WHERE number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchDetailQuery.number}, '%') )
GROUP BY bi.pid, bi.type, number, bi.direction, bi.nums
ORDER BY time DESC
